description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

Returns the console sign-in URL for a checked-out profile. Available for `CLI` and `CONSOLE` checkout types; throws an error for `PROGRAMMATIC` checkouts. The response always contains a `url` key; some application types (e.g. OpenShift) may include additional keys such as `idpName`. When `spInitiatedSSO=true`, returns the tenant SAML endpoint URL instead of the application URL.

variable.description: (Required) Transaction ID returned by the checkout call
(Required) Transaction ID returned by the checkout call

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

Checkout a profile for a specific environment. Use `accessType=CONSOLE` to obtain a federated console session or `accessType=PROGRAMMATIC` to obtain short-lived programmatic credentials (e.g. AWS access keys). The response `transactionId` is required for subsequent getToken, getConsoleUrl, and check-in calls. For ITSM-gated profiles, supply `ticketId` and `ticketType` in the request body.

query.description: Type of access to checkout. `CONSOLE` grants a federated web-console session; `PROGRAMMATIC` grants short-lived API credentials; `CLI` (default) for CLI-based access.
Legacy alias for `accessType`. Ignored when `accessType` is provided.
